top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Set to Fall, Treasury Yields Slide: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set for a modest decline as oil surged on the prospect of renewed US-Iran conflict, reviving inflation concerns. Bonds will be in focus after Treasuries rebounded.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft enables Windows settings backup by default for orgs
top_signals.summary: Microsoft announced that Windows settings backup and restore is now enabled by default on all Microsoft Entra-joined or Microsoft Entra hybrid-joined enterprise systems upgraded to Windows 11 26H2. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: Lloyds, Visa settle $750,000 using USDC in live cross-border pilot
top_signals.summary: Lloyds used USDC to settle $750,000 of payment obligations with Visa during a seven-day live cross-border pilot.
